decision_gates: Which deliverables need free form fixed canvas authoring and which need the one surface that yields a press resolution file, given that neither can do the other's job.
Which of two captures of the same feature is the current build, and how to say so when the client believes both are theirs.
Whether a capture can join the common device treatment at all, or has to be replaced or dropped rather than enlarged.
Knockout route per portrait: the one call route for sitters who separate from the wall, against a material named selection inverted and filled where shirt and wall run to the same value.
Whether the mark is recoverable as a flat plate trace, a colour accurate plate, or a rebuilt lockup, judged at reproduction size rather than at canvas size.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged against a per seat band defended to a finance director, plus the real numeric weight per family.
How to present three headline figures drawn from three different periods without either misleading the investor or gutting the chart.
How much air the sheets and deck carry. At this band restraint is the design, and a dense benefit stuffed tile is a correct looking wrong answer.
Whether the fourteen files are fourteen people, and how to report a duplicate and a missing sitter rather than quietly shipping thirteen.
Field mapping strategy for the badge, which depends entirely on what the conversion exposes rather than on what the printed badge shows.
Which merge delivery route guarantees that the right badge carries the right name, given that positional labelling on raster output cannot be trusted for identity.
why_not_vlm: Paste this brief and these assets into a frontier image model and it returns handsome pictures of SaaS collateral. IDENTITY: these are this product's real interface screens and these fourteen are real people whose badges go round their necks, and the mark must be recovered from the only file that exists rather than reinvented, because a regenerated mark is another company's logo. SPEC: fourteen pages, one per roster name, each carrying that person's own photograph at press resolution from the printer's own artwork, and three social canvases at three exact sizes inside one file, none of which a generated image satisfies or can even be checked for. EDITABILITY: the whole engagement is defined by the client changing pricing every quarter without coming back, so a flat raster of a tier table is worthless to them. And the middle of the work is verification against material reality: does this mark still read at footer size, did the emphasis survive the import, is this frame the shape the printed badge implied.
doability_proof: Every link is verified live in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account); five honestly counted surfaces, no banned capability and no dead surface. IMAGING: apply_adjustments masked and unmasked, select_by_prompt with returnBbox, select_subject, invert_selection, fill_area, remove_background in both the transparent and backgroundColor forms, crop_to_bounds, crop_and_resize with its tradeoffs and detection_confidence, and vectorize are all verified headless across 27 live calls; crop_and_resize is documented to upscale silently to a two times cap with the tradeoffs array as the only signal, and vectorize takes no options at all so a colour plate returns dozens of near identical fills, which is exactly the mark checkpoint. EXPRESS: mixed canvas sizes in one export, real tables with per cell backgrounds and strokes, inline SVG as native editable vector, exact letter canvases from absolute units, and a genuine editable dcx findable by asset_search are all verified; multi layer box shadow is documented as a hard truncation to layer one and backdrop filter as dropped, both at HTTP success, and the rendition preview is documented as PAGE 1 ONLY, which is why the tier checkpoint can only be caught in the returned markup. Transport is pinned through asset upload with media_type text/html because embedded photography passes the 70 KB inline threshold immediately, and no photograph is ever left as a URL. FONTS: recommend once per role, styles for the non standard numeric weights, find_fonts laundering and one kit are verified end to end, including a browser proving licensed faces load. INDESIGN: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt, prepare_indd_merge_template, document_merge_data_layout with an @ prefixed image column plus additionalImageFiles, and document_render_layout at 300 DPI are all verified synchronous and headless, with frame granularity documented as not under the caller's control and textContent documented as lossy while the validator still reports valid. Delivery uses the ordered routes only, since multi record raster labels are documented as reversed. STOCK AND BOARDS: short queries only, orientation never passed, license returned a real 7360x4912 frame, boards persist with a hard cap of 12 placements per call and 201 meaning partial. AVOIDED: no video or audio, no vector render or vector merge, no fill_text, no animate_design, no replace_image, no text to image, no upscaling, no compositing, no OCR, no bleed claim on a PDF derived template, no batch above 20, and no claim of a file export out of Express.

engagement_title: Alderwood Scholars Fund, twentieth winter: bring a year of volunteer photography to one house look, recover the crest off an enamel sign, then ship the impact report, the donor deck, the winter appeal set and the five centre banner run
vertical: Nonprofit and community: an education charity running five after school learning centres and a scholarship fund (greater Providence, Rhode Island)
real_brief_anchor: Primary anchor: the Freelancer.com large format banner brief from a local tutoring institute wanting a "clean, premium, professional" flex banner that stays readable from the road, with subject hinting devices, a confident but minimal photograph of students, understated geometric elements and a print ready CMYK PDF, plus its companion multi branch banner run where every branch carries its own address block. Both are laundered here to the coined, secular, IP clean Alderwood Scholars Fund in Providence, Rhode Island, and the regional festival season is replaced by the Western year end giving season, since every branch locality in the source is a generic address string rather than a real institution. Co-anchors: the Upwork twentieth anniversary commemorative poster brief, which asked for landmarks and community traditions woven into one cohesive composition in a "festival posters, folk-art illustration, screenprint aesthetics" register (the real client is a named Louisiana school, fully laundered), and the marketplace production brief asking for an approved mark turned into production ready files for a scholarship funding drop. The ledger's verdict is STRENGTHEN, and the concept survives whole. It is repositioned only where the connector demands it: from scratch folk illustration and regional script typesetting are not connector work, so the poster directions are built from a recovered crest, graded photography and authored vector rather than illustrated, and the per branch run becomes a genuine record per page merge off the printer's own artwork, which CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) verifies end to end.
client_one_liner: Turn our programme numbers and our field photographs into the pieces we put in front of donors this winter, the impact report, the donor presentation and the banners for all five centres, and leave them editable so we can update the figures next year.
client_brief:
Alderwood Scholars Fund, twentieth winter appeal

We run five after school learning centres around Providence and a small scholarship fund. This winter is our twentieth year, and the year end appeal is where roughly half our giving comes from. We are four staff and a board.

What we have. A year of photographs taken at the centres, mostly on volunteers' phones, a few on a camera somebody lent us. A spreadsheet of our programme numbers and where the money went, prepared by our treasurer. Our centre list with addresses, hours and each coordinator. The donor honour roll, which is long. A photograph of the enamel crest on the front wall of the Eastgate centre, which is the only place our crest still exists as artwork. Last year's banner file from the printer.

What we need. An impact report we can send and print: what changed for the students, where the money went, and three stories from the centres. A presentation for major donor meetings that ends on the ask. Banners for all five centres for the appeal, each with its own centre name, address, hours and coordinator, going to the same printer as last year. Two poster directions for the twentieth year that we can put in each window. A set of appeal posts for wide, square and tall.

One centre has almost nothing usable of children at work, so find us something honest that fits.

Everything editable, because our numbers change every year and we cannot commission this again.

Our average gift is forty five dollars and our major asks run five thousand to fifty thousand. Our donors are forty five to seventy, they give because they believe in the work, and several of them read our overhead ratio before they read anything else. It should look careful and plain spoken, like an organisation that spends money on students. Not glossy, not desperate. And tell us anything you could not do.
price_band_and_audience: An average gift of 45 dollars alongside major asks of 5,000 to 50,000, from donors aged 45 to 70 who are mission motivated and who inspect the overhead ratio before the narrative. The band is load-bearing. Trust at this level is bought with restrained grounds, honest photography, evidence led charts and a spend table that reconciles in public, and every visible dollar of production has to look like it came out of an in house afternoon rather than an agency retainer. Push into glossy fundraising grammar, heavy gradients, urgency banners, countdown devices, stock smiles and a saturated hero, and this specific donor reads wasted overhead and gives less, which is the one failure mode that costs the client real money. Push the other way into austere charity minimalism, grey text on grey, no faces, no numbers, and a fifty thousand dollar ask has nothing to stand on. The twentieth year also has to feel like a milestone without becoming a celebration of the organisation rather than the students. A real posted commission of this shape runs 1,500 to 3,500 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.sector: An education charity running five after school learning centres and a small scholarship fund across greater Providence.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2006, greater Providence, Rhode Island, four staff, a volunteer board and five centres.
brand_identity.about: Alderwood Scholars Fund runs five after school learning centres and a scholarship fund for students across greater Providence. This winter marks our twentieth year. The year end appeal carries roughly half our giving, and it works because donors trust that the money reaches the students rather than the overhead. We show our numbers plainly, name where every dollar went, and let the work speak.
brand_identity.audience: Mission motivated donors aged forty five to seventy who give because they believe in the work. Several read the overhead ratio before the narrative and reward organisations that look like they spend on students, not on production.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Average gift 45 dollars, major asks 5,000 to 50,000. Community scale and grassroots: careful and credible rather than glossy, every visible dollar of production reading as an in house afternoon rather than an agency retainer.
brand_identity.typography: A humanist serif for headlines and the twentieth year milestone, with a plain humanist sans for body, captions and tables. Numbers set in a clear tabular figure so charts and the spend breakdown read honestly. The feel is settled and civic, not corporate.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, specific, quietly proud. It credits students and staff, states periods on every figure, and never begs. Example line the brand would write: "Last year, ninety students finished the programme. Here is where your gift went, line by line."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The crest was drawn by a trustee in 2006 and the artwork files are long gone. The only surviving version is the enamel crest on the front wall of the Eastgate centre, which we have as a single handheld photograph. There is no vector, no guideline sheet and no recorded palette or type.
brand_identity.values: Money goes to students, and the books reconcile in public.

assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Cranston Fields' outcome (1.2) silently covers nine months, not twelve, because it opened last September, and no column states the period. Attendance is formatted inconsistently as percentages, a decimal and a value with a space before the percent sign.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_spend_by_programme.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The treasurer's spend lines by programme, including the audited total.
assets_supplied.visible_description: The spend lines as the treasurer exported them. The total at the bottom is the audited figure.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The restricted 15,000 dollar Ferra Family STEM Grant is entered against two programmes, so the ten spend lines sum to 453,000 against the audited total of 438,000. Amounts mix commas, dollar signs and bare integers.

assets_supplied.name: eastgate_crest_sign.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: Handheld photograph of the enamel crest on the front wall of the Eastgate centre: a compound lockup of small caps type set around a ring, with a lamp device inside it.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The only place our crest still exists as artwork. The original was drawn by a trustee in 2006."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It is a compound lockup on a photographed enamel surface, so a prompt naming the sign returns the sign rather than the ink, and a compound prompt can return the type ring while silently dropping the lamp and the inner rule. The enclosed counters inside the ring cannot be punched by background removal, which hands back a solid opaque disc, and on the sunlit half the ink runs close in value to the weathered enamel.

assets_supplied.name: alderwood_copy_pack.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Approved copy: the three centre stories, the appeal language, the trustee list, the donor honour roll of roughly three hundred and forty names, and the two ask amounts.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The copy as the board approved it. The honour roll cannot lose a single name."

acceptance_bar: The photographs read as ONE year of one organisation when laid together: one white point, one black point, one warmth, one crop logic, whatever phone or camera each came off. A frame that cannot be brought to the set is named, not shipped at eighty percent.
No delivered file exceeds its source frame's pixel dimensions, and nothing reaches a banner frame by being enlarged.
All five centres are genuinely represented. No centre's picture stands in for another, and any gap is named rather than filled from a neighbour.
The sourced frame for the thin centre sits inside the house look beside the volunteer photography rather than reading as bought.
The spend chart and the spend table reconcile to the same audited total shown in the report, and the note states exactly how the double counted line was treated.
Every outcome figure on every chart is labelled with the period it actually covers.
The honour roll appears complete, with every name present and readable, and no name lost at a page or column boundary.

The crest is placeable artwork rather than a picture of artwork: transparent ground, scalable with a real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle underneath, its lamp and inner rule intact, and it still reads at the size it reproduces at on a banner seen from the road and in a report footer.
In every delivered document the crest is live vector geometry and every word is text the client can retype next year.

Five banners, one page per centre, each carrying its own name, address, hours and coordinator with nothing truncated at trim, at true press resolution rather than screen resolution, and delivered to the printer's own artwork dimensions.
One type system, one palette and one grammar across report, deck, posters, appeal set and banners.
The appeal set is one working file carrying all three canvases, each keeping its own canvas size, delivered with the self contained source it was built from.

The note records the type system by role with family, foundry or designer and the actual weight used, every resize any tool reported, the centre reconciliation, the treatment of the spend discrepancy, and everything that could not be delivered, including anything the printer must be told.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Photoshop and Lightroom imaging, counting image_vectorize HERE rather than as an Illustrator surface
adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_initialize_file_upload and asset_finalize_file_upload, asset_inline_preview, image_auto_straighten, image_apply_adjustments (masked and unmasked), image_select_by_prompt with returnBbox, image_invert_selection, image_fill_area, image_remove_background, image_crop_to_bounds, image_crop_and_resize reading metadata.tradeoffs and detection_confidence, image_apply_monochromatic_tint, image_vectorize
adobe_surfaces.role: Brings roughly forty frames from a dozen phones and one borrowed camera to a single house look, straightens what is off level before any crop is locked, cuts the banner frames and the report frames to their own ratios without enlargement, brings the licensed frame into the same world as the volunteer photography, and recovers the crest at ink level off a photographed enamel sign with the vector hygiene the tracing tool never performs.

adobe_surfaces.surface: InDesign layout and data merge
adobe_surfaces.tools: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt (mapping and validation), prepare_indd_merge_template, document_merge_data_layout with an @ prefixed image column and additionalImageFiles, document_render_layout

It is also the only surface here that produces a real press resolution file, since the authoring surface returns an editable document and no exported file at all, and it is the surface where the honest limits (no bleed introduced into a converted document, no named press preset) have to be found and reported rather than assumed.

Every photograph must be pulled down and embedded as image data because a URL renders as an empty box at full success, the crest goes in as inline SVG inside an explicitly sized top left anchored wrapper, family and weight are declared on every text element, and the payload travels by uploaded URL because embedded photography passes the inline threshold immediately.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Fonts

The recommender refuses to pair by design, so the pairing is the agent's own art direction and has to land on careful and plain spoken rather than glossy or austere. Numeric weights are non standard per family and cannot be inferred from a style name, every name must be laundered into canonical PostScript form before the kit call because one bad name kills the whole kit, and the CSS must use the returned slug or the face falls back silently.

adobe_surfaces.role: Sources the honest frame the thin centre does not have, IP clean and at genuine camera scale with generative tech candidates excluded, choosing on whether the frame's own light can be brought to the house target rather than on the thumbnail. The Boards half persists the shortlist the four staff and the board sign off from, placed within the twelve per call cap with a partial success read as partial.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle which deliverable belongs on which surface before touching a pixel.
trajectory.judgement: The report, deck, posters and appeal set need free form fixed canvas authoring and must stay editable for next year's figures. The banners need one page per centre at the printer's dimensions and press resolution, which only the layout and merge surface produces. The brief pins both destinations, so there is nothing here to stall on.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming the surface per deliverable and the confirmed account tier that gates the export.

trajectory.action: Upload every supplied asset through initialize, PUT and finalize, holding each returned presigned URL against its role.
trajectory.judgement: Ordinary handoff discipline: a manifest keyed by role and by centre, so that forty artefacts later the agent still knows which URL is which frame and which centre it belongs to.
trajectory.produces: A manifest of presigned URLs keyed by role and centre.

trajectory.action: Preview the whole photographic library and triage it: which centre each frame is actually from, which device, which light, which are levelled, and which frames are large enough to carry a banner.
trajectory.judgement: The client believes it has a year from five centres. The pictures are the only thing that can settle whether that is five rooms or four, and reading rooms against centres is slower than reading folder names and is not the same act.
trajectory.produces: A per frame triage note with a centre reconciliation naming any duplicate room and any centre with nothing usable.

trajectory.action: Straighten what is off level, before any crop decision is locked.
trajectory.judgement: Straightening reframes the subject and eats edge pixels, so it cannot follow a crop.
trajectory.produces: Levelled masters where needed, originals untouched elsewhere.

trajectory.action: Fix one house target from the best lit frame and bring each selected frame toward it with its own call, recording the parameters applied.
trajectory.judgement: A dozen phones under classroom fluorescents and one borrowed camera is a dozen illuminants, so one batched identical parameter set is the wrong instrument. The target is a set that reads as one organisation, not thirty good photographs.
trajectory.produces: A graded selection at source scale with a per frame parameter log.

trajectory.action: Search with short generic queries, filter to photography, exclude generative tech candidates, license the frame for the thin centre and download it at full resolution.
trajectory.judgement: Choose on whether the frame's existing light can be brought to the house target, not on the thumbnail, and remember long descriptive queries return nothing and the orientation filter always returns zero.
trajectory.produces: One licensed, IP clean, camera scale frame.

trajectory.action: Bring the licensed frame into the house target and lay the whole selection out as a row to judge it as a set.
trajectory.judgement: The set is the deliverable, so the licensed frame has to join the world the volunteer photography lives in rather than the other way round, and whether it does is a judgement made side by side rather than frame by frame.
trajectory.produces: A single graded house set including the sourced frame, with the target recorded.

trajectory.action: Cut the banner frames at the banner's own ratio and the report frames at theirs, reading the returned tradeoff record on every crop rather than the success message.
trajectory.judgement: The tradeoff record is the only channel that says what happened to a frame's dimensions and it carries no warning language. A banner photograph brought to size by interpolation is soft at the scale a banner is actually seen at.
trajectory.produces: Two cut families with every returned tradeoff record transcribed.

trajectory.action: Recover the crest: an ink level selection naming the mark's own visual properties, the correct polarity, a bounds crop from the selection's own returned bounds, a trace, then a viewBox injected and the full canvas ground path removed.
trajectory.judgement: Three decisions the tools do not make: how to word the selection so it takes the ink and not the enamel, which polarity to trace, and whether the single colour trace or the colour accurate plate is the deliverable. Background removal is the wrong instrument entirely on an enclosed ring.
trajectory.produces: A placeable, scalable, transparent crest plus a reverse variant.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per typographic role, pull each family's style inventory for the real numeric weights, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit for the whole system.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is the agent's own, judged against a donor who checks the overhead ratio before the narrative. Careful and plain spoken is a narrow target between glossy and austere, and the weight cannot be inferred from the style name.
trajectory.produces: A one kit type system with family, foundry or designer and the actual numeric weight recorded per role.

trajectory.action: Convert the printer's banner PDF, export the round tripped document structure, and read the true frame inventory before promising any field mapping.
trajectory.judgement: What the printed banner looks like is not evidence of what the converted document contains. Frame granularity is a property of the conversion, and the inventory is the only honest basis for a mapping or for any promise to the printer.
trajectory.produces: A frame inventory with real bounds, applied type, object styles and any bleed the document actually carries.

trajectory.action: Build the field mapping against the true story text, prepare the merge template with the centre CSV and its image column, then verify by round tripping the document and confirming every placeholder actually landed.
trajectory.judgement: A successful preparation message is not evidence that a mapping landed, and the validator reports a mapping valid whether or not its offsets point where the agent believes. The verification is the evidence.
trajectory.produces: A merge template whose placeholders are confirmed present, and a CSV whose image column names the prepared banner plates.

trajectory.action: Merge one centre and look at it at trim, then merge all five and render the press files and the per centre proofs at true press resolution.
trajectory.judgement: One record inspected before five is the cheapest insurance, and the thing to look at is the end of every variable line at trim rather than the middle. Positional labels on raster output cannot be trusted for identity, so the ordered routes are the safe ones.
trajectory.produces: Five banner pages at press resolution, each identified to its centre, plus the note of what the printer must be told.

trajectory.action: Author the impact report as multiple roots: outcomes as inline SVG geometry with every figure labelled by its period, the spend breakdown as a real table reconciled to the audited total, the three centre stories with photographs embedded as image data, and the honour roll set in full.
trajectory.judgement: The spend discrepancy is a governance question rather than a layout one, and the only defensible treatments are to reconcile it visibly or to state it. The honour roll is the piece with the least design and the most risk, because a donor whose name is missing is the one who notices.
trajectory.produces: One self contained HTML carrying the report, retained as the durable source deliverable.

trajectory.action: Run the readiness check, upload the file and export by URL, then verify through both channels that exist: resolve the document's rendition and look at the first page, and parse the returned per page markup for every page after it.
trajectory.judgement: Every drop this importer performs returns success with no warning, and the rendition only ever shows the first artboard. Looking at page one of a report is not looking at the report.
trajectory.produces: A native editable Express report document with a page by page markup audit.

trajectory.action: Author the six root donor deck ending on the ask and the two A2 poster directions at true physical dimensions, reusing the same system and the recovered crest, then export and audit each root.
trajectory.judgement: Two poster directions have to be genuinely different arguments about the twentieth year rather than two colourways, and both have to be about students rather than about the organisation congratulating itself.
trajectory.produces: An editable deck document and two poster directions, each with its markup audit.

trajectory.action: Author the appeal set as three roots at three canvas sizes in one file, letting each root declare its own canvas, then export and audit.
trajectory.judgement: A global canvas override is what collapses a mixed size set, so the sizes stay in the HTML. The set has to survive the ask amount and the date changing, which is a structural decision about where the variable copy sits.
trajectory.produces: One document carrying all three appeal canvases plus its source.

trajectory.action: Create the trustees' shortlist board within the placement cap, re sending only entries the response names as failed, then write the handover note.
trajectory.judgement: A 201 is partial success and the vector crest is not boardable, so it belongs in the note instead. The note has to be specific enough that next year's update needs no archaeology, and honest about the limits, including that the editable documents cannot be exported to a file from that surface and that no bleed can be introduced into a converted document.
trajectory.produces: A persistent shareable board with nothing silently dropped, and the written handover.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed frame can actually live beside this photography. Everything visible while choosing is a small catalogue thumbnail, and the frame's true colour, contrast, grain and depth of field only exist after the full resolution download. Laid beside volunteer phone frames that have been pulled to one modest house target, a professionally lit frame can sit at a different level of finish entirely and read as bought, which is the precise thing this donor punishes. Whether the two can be brought to a common target, and what that target then costs the rest of the set, is only visible with the frames adjacent at full resolution.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering changes when this fires, not whether: even licensing first still requires downloading and placing the frame beside a graded set to know. Nothing states it, because the brief says only that one centre has nothing usable and asks for something honest that fits. The response is not a re run either, since the usual resolution is to move the house target itself, which re grades the whole selection, or to license a different frame chosen on different grounds.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re judge the house target with both families adjacent, re grade the volunteer set toward the new target, or abandon the licensed frame and license a different one on the light it carries rather than the subject it shows, then re cut every banner and report frame already cropped from the old grade.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: An impact report and a banner run in which one centre is represented by an obviously purchased photograph sitting a level of polish above the real work, in front of donors who read production spend as overhead.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the printer's banner artwork actually becomes once converted. The printed banner shows a centre name, a street line, an hours line and a coordinator line as four separate lines, but the conversion does not have to expose four mappable frames: a continuous block can arrive as one story, in which case fields must be placed by position inside that story rather than by frame. Worse, the readout of that story can omit an entire run while keeping its line break, so the string still looks well formed and every offset past the omission is short by exactly that run's length, and the mapping still reports as valid and the template preparation still reports success.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Frame granularity is a property of the conversion rather than a choice, and nothing about the printed sheet predicts it, so no ordering and no care establishes it without converting and inspecting. Nothing in the brief states it, since the client says only that the printer wants the same file back with each centre's details. The resolution is a different mapping computed against the true story text recovered from the round tripped document, not a repeat of the same call.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Rebuild every offset from the true story text, re prepare the template, re verify that each placeholder is genuinely present rather than trusting the success message, and only then merge, since a template short two fields merges five silently incomplete banners.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Five large format banners going to the printer with the hours line or the coordinator line missing or displaced on every one of them, paid for at large format prices and hung outside five centres for the whole appeal.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How the importer normalises the honour roll. Three hundred and forty names set the obvious way, as a multi column flow so they fit the page, come back as a single reflowed column: the multi column construction is discarded outright, the text runs down past the bottom of the fixed canvas, and the response reports success with no warning of any kind. The roll sits on the later pages of the report, and the document's rendition returns the first page only, so the returned per page markup is the sole channel in which any of this is visible, including whether the names that ran off the canvas are merely below the fold or genuinely absent.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: The normalisation happens at import, which is the last step, so no ordering precedes it, and getting it right first time would mean knowing which of several reasonable ways to set a long list survives, which no tool reports and no checklist enumerates. Nothing in the brief states it, since the client says only that the roll is long and cannot lose a name. The response is a different construction, explicit sibling columns rather than a flowed one, plus a re judged page break, which changes the document rather than repeating it.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re author the roll as explicit side by side columns with the break decided by hand, re balance the pages after it, re run the readiness check, re export, and audit every page from the returned markup rather than from the first page.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: An annual report delivered to a board with an unknown number of donors' names silently off the canvas, on the one page of the document those donors will look for themselves in first.

Delivered with a per frame parameter log, the centre reconciliation, and every resize any tool reported.

deliverables.name: Five centre appeal banner run

Live editable text in one licensed type system, the crest as real vector shapes, every photograph embedded as image data. Each delivered with the self contained source it was built from, which is the half that guarantees next year's update.

verifiers_auto.text: No crop tradeoff record captured in the run carries an upscale entry, and every downscale entry appears in the handover note.
verifiers_auto.how: Diff the tradeoff objects captured from every image call against the resize table in the note.

verifiers_auto.text: The banner output is exactly five pages, one per centre row, and its rendered proofs carry true press density rather than screen density.
verifiers_auto.how: Read the page count of the merged output and the recorded density of the rendered files, and match each file against the centre list.

verifiers_auto.how: Round trip the prepared document and search its stories for each expected placeholder token.

verifiers_auto.how: Parse the returned per root markup for placeholder image data and count path shape elements in the crest region on every root.

verifiers_auto.how: Read the font family attribute on every text node in the returned markup, and count the names present in the roll against the supplied copy pack.

verifiers_human.text: The photographs read as one year of one organisation rather than a folder from a dozen phones.
verifiers_human.how: Lay the graded selection out together at delivered scale and judge white point, black point, warmth and crop logic as a set.

verifiers_human.text: The sourced frame sits inside the house look rather than reading as bought.

verifiers_human.text: The note tells the staff something they did not already know, including everything that could not be delivered.

decision_gates: Which deliverables need free form fixed canvas authoring and which need the one surface that yields a press resolution file, given that neither can do the other's job.
Whether the photographic library really covers five centres, and how to tell a client that two of its folders are the same room.
How far to push a phone frame toward the house target before it stops being worth saving, against naming it and using fewer, better pictures.
Whether the licensed frame joins the house look or the house look moves to meet it, and what that costs the rest of the set.

Selection wording on the enamel sign: naming the sign takes the enamel, naming the ink's own visual properties takes the crest, and background removal on an enclosed ring is the wrong instrument entirely.
Which crest variant carries the banners, judged at the size a banner is actually read from rather than at full canvas.
How to treat a spend file that does not reconcile to its own audited total: correct it visibly, footnote it, or refuse to chart it, on a piece read by donors who check exactly this.
Whether to label, footnote or drop the outcome figure that covers nine months, on a chart whose neighbours cover twelve.
How to set a three hundred and forty name honour roll on a fixed canvas so that no name is at risk, which is a structural decision made before any type is chosen.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged against careful and plain spoken between glossy and austere, plus the real numeric weight per family.
What to promise the printer about the converted artwork, given what the conversion actually carries, rather than repeating last year's assumptions.
Whether the two poster directions are genuinely two arguments about the twentieth year or two colourways of one.
why_not_vlm: Paste this brief and these assets into a frontier image model and it returns a handsome charity report about nobody. IDENTITY: these are this organisation's actual students, its actual five centres with their actual addresses and coordinators, and a crest drawn by a trustee in 2006 that must be recovered from the only surviving artefact rather than reinvented, because a regenerated crest belongs to no one. SPEC: five pages, one per centre, on the printer's own artwork at the printer's dimensions and at press resolution, three appeal canvases at three exact sizes in one file, and an honour roll of roughly three hundred and forty names in which every single name must be present, none of which a generated image satisfies or can be checked for. EDITABILITY: the entire engagement exists because the figures change every year and this client cannot commission it again. And the middle of the work is verification against material reality: does this licensed frame sit with the real photography, did the conversion expose the fields the printed banner implied, did the last name in the roll survive the page.
doability_proof: Every link is verified live in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account); five honestly counted surfaces, no banned capability and no dead surface. IMAGING: auto_straighten, apply_adjustments masked and unmasked, select_by_prompt with returnBbox, invert_selection, fill_area, remove_background, crop_to_bounds, crop_and_resize with its tradeoffs and detection_confidence, monochromatic tint and vectorize are all verified headless across 27 live calls; the substrate versus ink prompt asymmetry, the partial selection on compound marks, the solid disc failure of remove_background on an enclosed ring, the missing viewBox and the opaque path zero are all documented live findings, and crop_and_resize is documented to upscale silently to a two times cap with the tradeoffs array as the only signal. INDESIGN: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt, prepare_indd_merge_template, document_merge_data_layout with an @ prefixed image column plus additionalImageFiles, and document_render_layout at 300 DPI are verified synchronous and headless, one record per page confirmed with page count equal to row count; frame granularity is documented as not under the caller's control (a continuous flow converted to exactly one text frame), textContent is documented as lossy while the validator still reports valid and preparation still reports success, and both the absence of bleed in a converted document and the invalid press preset enum are documented, which is why the printer note is a deliverable rather than a claim. Delivery uses the ordered routes only, since multi record raster labels are documented as reversed. EXPRESS: multi page and mixed canvas exports, real tables with per cell backgrounds and strokes, inline SVG as native editable vector, exact A2 and A4 canvases from mm units at 96 dpi, and a genuine editable dcx findable by asset_search are all verified; column-count is documented as dropped with the text reflowing as a single column at HTTP success, and the rendition preview is documented as PAGE 1 ONLY, which is why the honour roll checkpoint can only be caught in the returned markup. Transport is pinned through asset upload with media_type text/html because embedded photography passes the 70 KB inline threshold immediately, and no photograph is ever left as a URL. FONTS: recommend once per role, styles for the non standard numeric weights, find_fonts laundering and one kit are verified end to end. STOCK AND BOARDS: short queries only, orientation never passed, license returned a real 7360x4912 frame, boards persist with a hard cap of 12 placements per call and 201 meaning partial. AVOIDED: no video or audio, no vector render or vector merge, no variable QR, no fill_text, no animate_design, no text to image, no from scratch illustration, no upscaling, no compositing, no OCR, no batch above 20, and no claim of a file export out of Express.

engagement_title: Lanternwood Folk Fest 2027 on sale kit: rebuild the performer laminate run off last year's printed pass, recover the festival mark from the painted banner, and carry both onto the headliner posters and the lineup announcement
vertical: Party, Events and Promotion: an independent three stage folk and roots music festival held on a farm outside Burlington, Vermont, sixth edition, roughly four thousand weekend tickets
real_brief_anchor: Primary anchor: the Upwork event credential post quoted in the ledger's grounding_note, an events team wanting personalised backstage and performer passes produced from a lineup list against a designer built page layout template, delivered both as one file the printer can run and as separate passes to send out. Co anchor: the second Upwork post in the ledger, whose literal ask was to BUILD a page layout plugin that automatically reduces font sizes when a record is too long for its frame, because merged text runs overset and get clipped on export. That second post is a software commission and is out of scope for any design connector, but the PAIN it names is real, it is the single most common failure of a variable data print run, and this engagement makes the agent meet it by hand rather than automate it away. Both real posts name a client nowhere, so the line is laundered to the coined fictional festival Lanternwood Folk Fest; every performer, crew member, stage and sponsor name is invented and no real festival, venue, act or trademark appears in any task facing field. The ledger's repositioning note killed the original because it merged into a convert_pdf_to_indd output and relied on a per row data merge image field that cannot exist in a converted PDF. CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) changes what the honest fuller commission is: the convert, prepare, merge chain IS verified to bind fields end to end off a bare press PDF, provided the mapping offsets are computed from the true interchange story rather than from the tool's own readout, while the per row image field genuinely does not exist unless the source PDF carried a real placed image. So the corrected commission keeps the client's actual pass run and makes both of those realities load bearing, and it adds the rest of the kit that client obviously needed at the same on sale date.
client_one_liner: Twenty two people need laminates the printer can run, our designer left in 2024 and took the logo files, and on sale is the first Monday in February.
client_brief:
Lanternwood Folk Fest 2027, on sale kit

We run a three stage folk and roots festival on a farm outside Burlington. Sixth year. Weekend general admission is a hundred and forty five dollars, VIP is three hundred and twenty, and we sell about four thousand weekend tickets to a crowd between eighteen and forty who come as much for the discovery stages as for the headliners.

On sale is the first Monday in February and everything a ticket buyer or a performer sees has to be ready together.

Passes first, because the printer needs them earliest. Every performer, crew member and volunteer wears a laminate on a lanyard. Last year's pass is attached exactly as our printer returned it, and this year's is the same shape in our new colours. There are twenty two people on the roster and each needs their own pass carrying their name, their act, their role, the stages they are cleared for and the days they are on site. Roles are colour coded so gate staff can read them from two metres away. We need one file the printer can run in a single pass, and separate single passes we can email out to the acts.

Posters next. Three A2 directions for the headline nights, because we want to choose between them rather than be handed one. Then the lineup announcement set for social, a square, a tall one and a four by five, all in one working file, because acts move and we will be changing it ourselves through the winter.

The festival mark. Our designer left in 2024 and took the files with him. All that survives is a photograph of the painted banner that hangs over the main stage. We need the mark back as artwork we can put on the posters, the announcement set and the programme.

The photography is last year's, shot by two volunteers on two cameras across three stages. It does not read as one festival yet.

We also want the site plan drawn properly instead of the pencil scan, and one page recording our colours, our type and our mark so the next person does not have to do this again.
price_band_and_audience: Mid tier independent festival. Weekend general admission a hundred and forty five dollars, VIP three hundred and twenty, roughly four thousand weekend tickets, audience eighteen to forty, discovery led and scene literate rather than corporate. The band is load bearing in both directions. Push sparse and luxurious, with acres of white, a hairline serif and one small photograph, and it reads as a three hundred and twenty dollar tasting event rather than a farm field weekend, which suppresses general admission conversion where nearly all the revenue sits. Push the other way into a dense bargain flyer, with every act at the same size, a starburst price and clip art, and the VIP tier stops being credible and the discovery stages read as filler. The correct register is energetic and coherent: bold type at a real hierarchy, atmospheric photography carrying the field and the night, a lineup that plainly distinguishes headline from discovery, and colour coding a gate steward reads at two metres in daylight. A posted commission of this shape and scope runs 1,800 to 3,500 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Three stages, one field, after dark.
brand_identity.sector: An independent three stage folk and roots music festival held on a farm outside Burlington, sixth edition.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2022, a farm outside Burlington, Vermont, a small core team programming roughly four thousand weekend tickets.
brand_identity.about: Lanternwood is an independent folk and roots festival on a farm outside Burlington, now in its sixth year. Three stages, a weekend under the lights, and a bill that gives its discovery acts the same care as its headliners. People come as much for the acts they have not heard of yet as for the ones on the poster, and the whole thing runs on that promise.
brand_identity.audience: A discovery led crowd aged eighteen to forty, scene literate rather than corporate, who buy on atmosphere and word of mouth and expect the field weekend to feel real rather than packaged.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Weekend general admission 145 dollars, VIP 320, roughly four thousand weekend tickets. Mid tier independent: energetic and coherent, a credible VIP tier without tipping into either luxury restraint or bargain flyer chaos.
brand_identity.typography: A bold condensed display face for the lineup and the headline nights, carrying a real hierarchy that separates headline from discovery at a glance, paired with a sturdy grotesque for body, set times and the site plan legend. The feel is poster energy, warm and a little rough, never polished.
brand_identity.voice: Warm, direct, a bit of grit. It talks up the discovery stages as loudly as the headliners and keeps sponsor and billing lines exactly as agreed. Example line the brand would write: "Gates at five. Three stages till late. Come early for the names you will be bragging about next year."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: Our designer left in 2024 and took the logo files. The mark now survives only as a photograph of the painted canvas banner that has hung over the main stage since 2022. There is no vector, no source file and no written type or colour spec. Last year's photography was shot by two volunteers on two cameras with no brief.
brand_identity.values: Give the discovery acts the poster space, and keep the weekend feeling like a field rather than a brand.

assets_supplied.name: lanternwood_pass_2026.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: Last year's performer laminate artwork, the press PDF the printer returned, portrait, one pass per page, with a photo box, a name block, an act line, a role bar and a stage and day strip.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Last year's pass, exactly as the printer sent it back. Same shape this year, new colours, new names."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The five blocks that read as separate fields on the printed page are one continuous text flow once converted, so there is nothing to map field by field, and the readout used to build a mapping silently omits the low contrast handle run while keeping its line break, which leaves every offset past it short by exactly that run while the validator still answers VALID and the prepare step still answers completed successfully. The photo box is drawn artwork rather than a placed image, so no graphic frame exists for a per performer headshot to bind to, and nothing in the printed page or the file listing says so.

assets_supplied.name: lanternwood_roster_2027.csv
assets_supplied.kind: Twenty two rows: person, act, role, stages cleared, days on site, social handle, and a column of headshot filenames.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Everyone who wears a laminate. It is final apart from one crew name we are still confirming."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Several act strings run long (a duo billed with a guest brass section, one act carrying a parenthetical subtitle) and the pass measure does not overset visibly, it simply stops rendering at the frame edge, so the merge succeeds, the page count still equals the row count and the record reads as complete until the trim is examined. Role values arrive in three different spellings and cases across the twenty two rows, and the colour coding the client wants is keyed to them.

assets_supplied.name: lanternwood_banner_mainstage.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: Handheld photograph of the painted canvas banner over the main stage, carrying the festival mark: a lantern with cut window panes, sitting inside a ring of small caps type, over a hand painted rule.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The only place our mark still exists since the drive went. It has hung there since 2022."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The trace comes back clean and convincing at canvas size, but the lantern's window panes and the counters inside the ring close up at the size the mark actually reproduces in the announcement set corner lockup and the site plan legend, on the dark ground those two sit on, and nothing reports it because the trace itself succeeded. The banner's right third hangs in shade where the painted ink and the canvas run close in value, so a selection worded for the ink alone comes back short on that side.

assets_supplied.name: lanternwood_stage_frames/ (14 frames, camera scale)
assets_supplied.kind: Last year's performance photography, shot by two volunteers on two different bodies across the three stages, mixed daylight, dusk and stage light.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Everything we have from last year. Some of it is lovely. It was two people with two cameras and no brief."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three of the fourteen are the same act photographed on the same night from three positions, and one of the three 2027 headliners appears in none of the fourteen at all, which no filename, caption or column reveals and which only surfaces when the frames are read against the billing. Two frames were shot into the low sun and sit a full stop hotter than the rest of the set.

assets_supplied.name: lanternwood_lineup_2027.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Approved billing: headline and discovery acts per stage per day, set times, the ticket tiers, the on sale date and the two sponsor lines that must appear.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The billing as approved. The sponsor lines are contractual and cannot be reworded."

assets_supplied.name: lanternwood_site_plan_pencil.png
assets_supplied.kind: Scan of the site manager's hand drawn plan: three stages, the gates, the food row, camping, first aid and the accessible route.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "How the field is laid out. Somebody needs to draw this properly."

acceptance_bar: Twenty two passes exist, one person per page, the page count equals the roster count, and every field on every pass carries that person's own value with nothing left inherited from last year's artwork.
No pass truncates. Every act string, every role and every stage and day list is present in full at trim on the delivered artwork, not merely accepted by the merge.
Separate single passes exist, one per person, named to the roster, and each one holds the right person.
Proofs are at true print resolution and sized to the pass trim, not a screen scale preview standing in for a proof.
Role colour coding is one scheme, legible from two metres in daylight, with the roster's inconsistent role spellings reconciled rather than passed through.

The festival mark is placeable artwork rather than a picture of artwork: transparent, scalable with a real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle riding underneath it, and it still reads as our mark at the smallest place it appears and on our darkest ground.
Three A2 poster directions sit in one working file and are genuinely three directions, not one layout in three colourways.
The announcement set is one working file carrying the square, the tall and the four by five, each keeping its own canvas size, with text we can retype and the mark as real vector shapes.
Every photograph in every delivered layout is actually present, on every canvas and not only the first one.

The fourteen stage frames read as one festival when laid together: one white point, one black point, one crop logic. A frame that cannot be brought to the set is named rather than shipped at eighty percent.
Every act billed on a poster is represented by a photograph that is actually of that act, and no photograph stands in for two.
One type system across posters, announcement set, site plan and basis page, with the note naming per role the family, its foundry or designer, and the actual weight used.
Anything that could not be produced is named plainly in the note rather than approximated silently.

adobe_surfaces.surface: InDesign layout and data merge
adobe_surfaces.tools: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt (mapping and validation passes), prepare_indd_merge_template, document_merge_data_layout (recordRange All and per record), document_render_layout (createSeparateFiles, resolution)
adobe_surfaces.role: The entire laminate run, built backwards out of a bare press PDF because the client has no native file. This surface carries the reverse engineering of last year's artwork into a live merge template, the twenty two record run as one press file with one person per page, the per record single passes named to the roster, and the true resolution proofs. It is also where the two hardest realities of the commission live: what the conversion actually exposes as addressable frames, and whether a mapping the validator blessed actually landed.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Photoshop and Lightroom imaging, including image_vectorize which is counted HERE and not as an Illustrator surface
adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_initialize_file_upload and asset_finalize_file_upload, asset_inline_preview, image_auto_straighten, image_apply_adjustments (masked and unmasked), image_select_by_prompt (returnBbox), image_invert_selection, image_fill_area, image_crop_to_bounds, image_crop_and_resize (reading metadata.tradeoffs and detection_confidence), image_remove_background, image_vectorize
adobe_surfaces.role: Bringing fourteen frames shot by two volunteers on two bodies to one festival look, one frame at a time toward a single target rather than one batched move across a mixed set, plus the confined corrections the two into the sun frames need. It is also the whole of the mark recovery: an ink level selection off a photographed painted banner, the polarity decision before tracing, the bounds crop driven by the selection's own returned box, and the vector hygiene the tracing tool does not perform for anyone.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Express, HTML authoring to a native editable document
adobe_surfaces.tools: get_account_type, create_visual_design_express_skill, html_export_readiness_skill, asset upload with media_type text/html, export_html_to_express, asset_search (CCAsset), asset_get_presigned_urls, asset_inline_preview
adobe_surfaces.role: Everything the client will edit themselves: three A2 poster directions in one document, the mixed canvas announcement set, the site plan drawn as inline SVG so it stays editable vector, and the basis page. This is the only surface in the connector that composes free form fixed canvas layout at all. Every photograph must be pulled down and carried as embedded image data because a reference renders as an empty box at full success, the mark goes in as inline SVG inside an explicitly sized wrapper anchored top and left, and family and weight are declared on every text element.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Fonts
adobe_surfaces.tools: font_recommend (once per typographic role), font_styles, find_fonts, get_fontkit_embed_url
adobe_surfaces.role: One type system across the posters, the announcement set, the site plan and the basis page. The recommender refuses to pair by design, so the pairing is the agent's own art direction and has to land on a hundred and forty five dollar farm field weekend rather than on either a luxury or a bargain register. Numeric weights are non standard per family and cannot be inferred from a style name, one unlaundered name kills the entire kit call, and the CSS must carry the returned slug or the face falls back with no error anywhere.

adobe_surfaces.surface: Adobe Stock and Adobe Boards, counted as ONE surface
adobe_surfaces.tools: asset_search (entityScope StockAsset, short generic queries, contentType filter, orientation never passed), asset_license_and_download_stock, boards_create_new_board, boards_add_items_to_board
adobe_surfaces.role: Sources the one thing the archive does not contain, a field and dusk crowd atmosphere frame for the poster direction that needs it, IP clean and at genuine camera scale with generative candidates excluded. The Boards half persists the selects the festival's two directors sign the poster direction off from, placed within the twelve per call cap, with a partial success read as partial rather than as a failure.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle which deliverable lands on which surface before touching anything.
trajectory.judgement: The pass run is a record per page variable data job and belongs on the layout and merge surface; the posters, the announcement set, the site plan and the basis page are free form fixed canvases and can only be authored. The brief already pins both destinations, so there is nothing here to stall on.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming a surface per deliverable and the confirmed account tier that gates the export at the end.

trajectory.action: Upload every supplied asset and hold each returned address against its role in a manifest.
trajectory.judgement: Ordinary handover discipline, and it matters more than usual here because the same roster file is consumed twice, once as merge data and once as billing to read the photography against.
trajectory.produces: A manifest of upload addresses keyed by role.

trajectory.action: Convert last year's pass PDF into an editable layout document, then export its interchange form and read what the document actually contains: how many text frames, what bounds, what typography, what graphic frames if any.
trajectory.judgement: The printed page is not evidence of structure. Frame granularity out of a PDF is not under anyone's control, and the only honest way to justify a mapping is to look at the converted document rather than at the artwork.
trajectory.produces: A converted layout document plus a frame inventory taken from its interchange form.

trajectory.action: Reconstruct each frame's true story text by concatenating the content runs from the interchange file, compute every mapping offset from that reconstructed string, and build the mapping against integer frame identifiers.
trajectory.judgement: The readout the mapping tool hands back is a convenience, not the document. Offsets computed from anything other than the true story are wrong in a way nothing downstream complains about.
trajectory.produces: A mapping built on reconstructed offsets, with the reconstruction retained for the note.

trajectory.action: Prepare the merge template, then verify it by exporting the interchange form again and confirming that every expected field placeholder is actually present in the story.
trajectory.judgement: Completed successfully is a status, not a verification. The only thing that proves a placeholder landed is finding it in the document afterwards.
trajectory.produces: A merge template whose placeholder inventory has been read back and reconciled field by field.

trajectory.action: Preview all fourteen stage frames and triage them against the approved billing: which volunteer and which body, which sit hot, which stage, and crucially which act each frame actually shows.
trajectory.judgement: The client believes the archive covers the festival. Counting files is not reading them, and only the billing can settle whether fourteen frames means fourteen usable subjects.
trajectory.produces: A per frame triage note covering illuminant, tilt, exposure and subject identity against the billing.

trajectory.action: Straighten what is off level, then fix one festival target from the most workable frame and correct each of the fourteen toward it with its own call, recording the parameters applied.
trajectory.judgement: Straightening reframes and eats edge pixels so it cannot follow a crop. The target is a set, not fourteen good pictures: one batched move applies one identical correction, which is exactly wrong across two bodies and three lighting situations.
trajectory.produces: Graded masters at source scale with a per frame parameter log.

trajectory.action: Apply confined corrections where a whole frame move goes wrong, selecting by the material's own visual properties rather than by the object it sits on.
trajectory.judgement: Prompt wording is the entire gate: naming the substrate pulls the selection to the substrate. The two into the sun frames need the sky held back without taking the crowd with it.
trajectory.produces: Corrected frames where a global move would have taken the field yellow or the stage flat.

trajectory.action: Recover the mark off the banner: an ink level selection naming the mark's own visual properties, the correct polarity before tracing, a bounds crop driven by the selection's own returned box, then a viewBox injected and the opaque full canvas ground path removed.
trajectory.judgement: Three decisions no tool makes: how to word the selection so it takes the paint and not the canvas, which polarity to trace, and whether the two colour trace or a colour accurate plate is the deliverable. Background removal is the wrong instrument on an enclosed ring entirely.
trajectory.produces: A placeable, scalable, transparent mark plus a colour accurate variant.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per typographic role, pull the family style inventories for the real numeric weights, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit for the whole kit of work.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is the agent's own, judged against a hundred and forty five dollar weekend ticket and a discovery led crowd. A weight cannot be inferred from a style name, and a display cut is reached by its own slug rather than by a heavier number.
trajectory.produces: A one kit type system with family, foundry and actual weight recorded per role.

trajectory.action: Merge all twenty two records into one press file with one person per page, then render proofs at true print resolution and look at the pages themselves rather than at the count.
trajectory.judgement: Page count equal to row count proves the run assembled, not that a record is complete. The roster is the only place where the longest strings live and the artwork is the only place they can be judged.
trajectory.produces: A press file for the printer plus proofs at trim resolution, inspected page by page.

trajectory.action: Produce the separate single passes, one per person, and name each file to the roster on download.
trajectory.judgement: Multi record raster output cannot be named by its position in the returned list, so identity has to come from a route that guarantees it rather than from the order the addresses arrive in.
trajectory.produces: Twenty two single passes, each named to the person it carries.

trajectory.action: Search with short generic queries for the field and dusk atmosphere frame, filter to photography, exclude generative candidates, license and download at full resolution.
trajectory.judgement: Choose the frame whose existing light can be brought to the festival target rather than the prettiest thumbnail. Long descriptive queries return nothing and the orientation filter always returns nothing, so neither is used.
trajectory.produces: One licensed, IP clean, camera scale frame.

trajectory.action: Author one self contained file carrying three A2 poster roots, each root declaring its own canvas, with every photograph inlined as embedded image data and the mark placed as inline SVG inside an explicitly sized wrapper anchored top and left.
trajectory.judgement: A photograph left as a reference is not a photograph, an auto sized wrapper anchored from the right throws its contents off the canvas, and a global canvas override is what collapses a multi root set. The design work is whether the three are genuinely three directions.
trajectory.produces: An export ready source file for the poster series, retained as the durable half of the deliverable.

trajectory.action: Run the readiness check, export, then verify through the two channels that exist: resolve the document's rendition and look at the first canvas, and audit the returned per canvas markup for the other two.
trajectory.judgement: Every drop this importer performs returns success with no warning of any kind, and the rendition only ever shows the first artboard. Looking at canvas one is not looking at the deliverable.
trajectory.produces: A native editable poster document, an inspected first canvas and a markup audit for the rest.

trajectory.action: Author and export the announcement set as one document carrying the square, the tall and the four by five at their own canvas sizes, plus the site plan drawn as inline SVG and the basis page recording colours, type and mark.
trajectory.judgement: Mixed canvas sizes in one document is the whole reason this set can be one working file. The site plan is vector work, so it is drawn rather than photographed, and the legend is where the mark reproduces smallest.
trajectory.produces: A native editable announcement and reference document with the site plan as real editable vector.

trajectory.action: Create the selects board, add the graded set and the licensed frame within the per call placement cap, re sending only the entries the response names as failed, then write the handover note.
trajectory.judgement: A partial success is reported as a success code, and vector artwork is not boardable so the mark belongs in the note instead. The note has to be specific enough that next year's freelancer does not repeat the archaeology.
trajectory.produces: A persistent shareable board with nothing silently dropped, and the written handover note.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What last year's pass actually becomes once it is a working document, and whether a mapping the tools blessed actually landed. The printed page shows five clearly separated blocks; the converted document can expose them as a single continuous text flow with no addressable per field frames, and the photo box that reads as a picture frame on paper can convert as drawn artwork with no graphic frame at all, which removes the per performer headshot binding the roster's filename column was written for. On top of that, the readout used to compute the mapping can silently omit a low contrast run while keeping its line break, so the string still looks well formed and every offset past the omission is short by exactly that run. The validator answers VALID with no warnings and the prepare step answers completed successfully, and only a placeholder inventory taken back out of the document reveals that some fields never landed.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it because the granularity of a converted PDF is a property of the source artwork and is not exposed until the conversion has been run and the document read back. Nothing in the brief, the file listing or the printed page states any of it: the client believes the pass is five fields and a photo box, which is what it looks like. The response is not a re run of the same chain, it is a different mapping strategy entirely, offsets computed inside one story against a reconstructed text, plus a decision about what to do with a headshot that now has nowhere to go.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Rebuild the mapping from a reconstructed story text rather than the readout, re prepare the template, re verify the placeholder inventory field by field, and re plan the headshot: either carry it as part of the delivered artwork by another route or tell the client plainly that this year's pass cannot carry a photo from this source.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A twenty two page run that assembles cleanly and prints with several fields blank or still carrying last year's artwork text, discovered by a gate steward on the first morning of a festival that has already been laminated.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether every record survives the frame it landed in. The pass measure is fixed, and a string longer than the measure does not overset visibly and does not raise a warning: it simply stops rendering at the frame edge, so the record looks complete, the run reports success and the page count still equals the row count. Which of the twenty two this happens to is a function of each act's own billing string against the inherited frame width, and no column, no count and no response says which.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: There is no ordering that avoids it and no parameter that prevents it, because the frame width is inherited from artwork the client supplied rather than chosen. Nothing states it either: the brief says the roster is final and lists what each pass must carry, and the acceptance line about nothing truncating is the printer's standing requirement, not a disclosure that a particular act is too long. And the response is not a re merge of the same thing, it is a craft decision per affected record about measure, about how the act line is set, or about what abbreviates without misbilling an act.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Read every page of the proof at trim rather than the run summary, identify the records that stop short, change the way the act and stage strings are set for the whole run so one rule covers all twenty two, then re merge, re render and re read.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Laminates printed and heat sealed with an act billed as half its own name and a performer cleared for stages the pass does not show, on the one artefact that cannot be corrected after it is made.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered mark still holds where it is smallest. The trace off the painted banner comes back clean, complete and convincing at canvas size, and it sits well at poster scale. At the size it actually reproduces in the announcement set corner lockup and in the site plan legend, over the dark ground both of those sit on, the lantern's window panes and the counters inside the type ring can close and fill in, and the hand painted rule can thicken into the ring. Nothing reports it, because the trace succeeded, the vector is valid and the placement is correct.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the reproduction size and the ground only exist once the canvases are composed, and no measurement is available anywhere in the connector to predict it. Nothing states it: the brief asks for the mark back as artwork for the posters, the announcement set and the programme, and never asks how small it can go. The response is not a re export, it is a different raster preparation upstream, a selection weighted to the paint body rather than to its edges, or a plate filled and traced at a different polarity, producing a second mark drawn for small use.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Prepare and trace a small use variant of the mark from the banner by a different route, judge it at true reproduction size on the actual dark ground rather than on canvas, re place it in the announcement set and the legend, re export, and record the two variants and their intended sizes in the basis page and the note.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: An announcement set going out on the on sale morning to four thousand ticket buyers with the festival's mark reduced to a dark blob in the corner, and a programme legend where the lantern has no windows.

deliverables.name: Lanternwood 2027 performer laminate run
deliverables.spec: Twenty two laminates built off last year's printed artwork: one press file the printer can run with one person per page and page count equal to roster count, plus twenty two separate single passes named to the roster, plus proofs at true print resolution sized to the pass trim. Every field carries that person's own value, nothing is inherited from last year's text, no record truncates at trim, and the role colour coding is one reconciled scheme.

deliverables.name: Lanternwood headliner poster series, three A2 directions
deliverables.spec: One native editable document carrying three A2 roots, each keeping its own canvas, presented as three genuinely different directions for the festival's two directors to choose between rather than one layout in three colourways. Live editable text in one licensed type system, the recovered mark as real vector shapes, every photograph carried as embedded image data, delivered with the self contained source file it was authored from.

deliverables.name: Lineup announcement set, site plan and festival basis page
deliverables.spec: One native editable document carrying the square, the tall and the four by five announcement canvases at their own sizes, the site plan redrawn from the pencil scan as real editable vector with a legend, and a basis page recording the palette, the type system by role and the mark with its intended sizes. Contractual sponsor lines present and unreworded on every canvas that carries them.

deliverables.name: Lanternwood house photography set
