trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle which deliverable lands on which surface before touching a frame.
trajectory.judgement: The store tiles and the campaign masters are raster work against a hard spec, the certificate run is genuine record per page variable data, and the campaign set has to be an authored fixed canvas document because the client will change the featured reference themselves. The brief pins each destination, so there is nothing here to stall on.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming a surface per deliverable, plus the confirmed account tier that gates the export at the end.

trajectory.action: Upload every supplied asset through initialize, PUT and finalize, holding each returned presigned URL against its role.
trajectory.judgement: Ordinary handoff discipline, but it has to be keyed by role rather than by filename, because the register, the detail frames and the product frames all refer to the same five references under different names.
trajectory.produces: A manifest of presigned URLs keyed by role and reference.

trajectory.action: Preview all twenty photographs and triage them: which session each campaign frame belongs to, which were shot polarized, where the light on the sapphire covers the dial, which product frames are bracelet and which are strap, and which reference each detail frame actually shows.
trajectory.judgement: The client asserts five references with a detail frame each and twenty four pieces to certificate. Only the pictures can settle whether that is true, and reading the detail frames against the reference list is slower than counting files and is not the same thing.
trajectory.produces: A per frame triage note covering session, polarizer state, where glare sits, bracelet versus strap, and detail frame identity.

trajectory.action: Level what is off level, before any crop decision is locked.
trajectory.judgement: Straightening reframes the subject and consumes edge pixels, so it cannot follow a crop that was chosen against the unlevelled frame.
trajectory.produces: Levelled masters where needed, originals untouched elsewhere.

trajectory.action: Fix one house target off the best lit frame and correct each of the nine campaign frames toward it with its own call, in colour, before any tint is committed, recording every parameter applied.
trajectory.judgement: The destination is a set, not nine good photographs. One batched call applies one identical parameter set, which is exactly wrong for two photographers and two polarizer states. Grading before tinting matters because a single tone treatment applied over frames that disagree hides the disagreement without removing it.
trajectory.produces: Nine graded colour masters at source scale with a per frame parameter log.

trajectory.action: Attempt the reflection work on the frames where the light on the sapphire lies over the dial: select the crystal by its own material properties rather than by the object it belongs to, confine the correction to that selection, and look at each result.
trajectory.judgement: Prompt wording is the entire gate, because naming the watch pulls the selection to the whole case. The correction has to be confined, since a whole frame move to hold the dial takes the steel flat.
trajectory.produces: Reflection worked frames, plus a read on each of what the correction actually moved.

trajectory.action: Commit the signature: one tint hue and one strength across the whole campaign set, then grain, judged as a row rather than frame by frame, and hold the true colour dial finish frame out of the treatment entirely.
trajectory.judgement: This is the irreversible craft decision in the commission. A tint hue chosen against a single hero will not survive contact with the flat lay on stone, and grain strength that reads as film at full size reads as noise at story scale. Carving out the true colour frame is an accuracy decision the client stated and the treatment must not soften it.
trajectory.produces: The signature campaign set at source scale, plus the untreated true colour frame, with the recipe recorded once rather than nine times.

trajectory.action: Knock out the five product references twice: onto the store's white ground for the listing tiles, and to genuine transparency for the dealer panels. Read every returned tradeoff record rather than the success message.
trajectory.judgement: The tradeoff record is the only channel that reports what a tool did to a frame's dimensions and it carries no warning language. The bracelet references and the mirror polished reference will not behave like the strap references.
trajectory.produces: Five white ground plates and five transparent variants, each with its returned tradeoff record transcribed.

trajectory.action: Cut the square store tiles at the store's spec with the watch optically centred, and crop the detail frames to the detail strip ratio, reading the confidence and bounds each crop returns.
trajectory.judgement: Optical centring is not geometric centring on a watch with a crown on one side and a bracelet running off both. A confident looking crop on sparse macro art is not evidence, and the fallback route costs calls the cheap route does not.
trajectory.produces: Five store tiles at spec, five dealer variants, and the detail strip with confidence readings recorded per crop.

trajectory.action: Search with short generic queries for the wrist and cuff lifestyle frame, filter to photography, exclude generative technology results, then license and download at full resolution.
trajectory.judgement: Choose the frame whose existing light can be brought to the house target rather than the prettiest thumbnail, and remember the thumbnail is all that exists before licensing. Long descriptive queries return nothing and the orientation filter always returns zero, so neither is used.
trajectory.produces: One licensed, IP clean, camera scale wrist frame.

trajectory.action: Bring the licensed frame to the house target, run the committed signature on it, and set it beside the treated campaign set to judge whether it belongs there.
trajectory.judgement: A bought frame either joins the world the nine live in or announces itself. The only place that can be settled is beside them, at the size the canvases actually use.
trajectory.produces: A treated lifestyle frame judged against the set, and a decision recorded either way.

trajectory.action: Convert last season's certificate to a working document, export the interchange format, and inspect what the conversion actually exposed: how many text frames, how many graphic frames, and what the true story text is when the runs are reassembled.
trajectory.judgement: The printed card is not evidence of its own structure. What can be addressed, and at what granularity, is a property of the conversion and not of the design, so it has to be looked at before anything is promised.
trajectory.produces: A true frame inventory and the reconstructed story text, held as the basis for every offset.

trajectory.action: Build the field mapping against the reconstructed story text, run it through validation, prepare the merge template, then round trip the document again and confirm every expected placeholder is genuinely present.
trajectory.judgement: Validation and a success message report intent, not outcome. The only proof a placeholder landed is finding it in the round tripped document, which is a step the tools never ask for.
trajectory.produces: A merge template whose placeholder inventory has been confirmed rather than assumed.

trajectory.action: Merge the register to one print ready file, one card per row in register order, binding each row's picture of its own piece through the image column, then merge again to a working document and render signing proofs at print resolution, and read the proofs.
trajectory.judgement: The image column is the whole reason the cutouts exist, and a naive run places one static picture on every card. Proofs at print resolution are the first moment the cutouts are seen at their real size on the card's coloured panel.
trajectory.produces: A print ready certificate run at one card per row, plus per card proofs at print resolution.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per typographic role, pull the family style inventories for the real numeric weights, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is the agent's own, judged against a four to twelve thousand dollar collector rather than against a luxury stereotype. The weight cannot be inferred from the style name and a display cut is reached by its own slug.
trajectory.produces: A one kit type system with family, foundry or designer, and the actual numeric weight recorded per role.

trajectory.action: Author one self contained document with four roots at four canvas sizes, carry every photograph as embedded image data, let each root declare its own canvas, declare family and weight on every text element, then upload the file and hold the returned URL.
trajectory.judgement: A photograph left as a reference is not a photograph, an auto sized wrapper anchored from the right throws its contents off the canvas, and a global canvas override is precisely what collapses a mixed size set. The design work is how much air a collector piece is given and how the single tone treatment holds against live type.
trajectory.produces: One export ready source document carrying the whole campaign set, retained as the durable half of the deliverable.

trajectory.action: Run the readiness check, export, then verify through the two channels that exist: resolve the document's rendition and look at the first canvas, and audit the returned per canvas markup for the other three.
trajectory.judgement: Every drop this importer performs returns success with no warning of any kind, and the rendition only ever shows the first artboard. Looking at canvas one is not looking at the deliverable.
trajectory.produces: A native editable document, an inspected first canvas, and a markup audit covering the other three.

trajectory.action: Create the selects board, add the treated set, the store tiles and the licensed frame within the per call placement cap, re sending only the entries the response names as failed, then write the handover note.
trajectory.judgement: A partial success is reported as a success, so the failed list is the only honest count. The note has to be specific enough that next season's freelancer does not repeat the archaeology.
trajectory.produces: A persistent shareable board with nothing silently dropped, and the written handover.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether there is anything under the light on the sapphire to bring back at all. On four campaign frames the softbox specular is fully clipped across part of the dial, so a highlight recovery confined to a crystal selection returns a successful call whose result is, in the region that matters, identical to the input. The readout is that nothing moves: no error, no warning, no tradeoff entry, just a new file that looks like the old one. Which of the four are clipped through and which merely look bright is a property of each exposure and cannot be read off the frame by eye at preview scale.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the question is whether the pixels carry information and the only instrument that answers it is the correction itself. Nothing in the brief or the deliverable list says the glare is unrecoverable; the client asks for the dial to read, which is a goal, not a disclosure. The response is not the same call again but a different route: confine a darkening or a controlled tint to the crystal so the glare reads as deliberate sheen, or accept that this frame cannot carry the dial and re plan which reference the campaign leads with.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re examine each of the four frames after the correction rather than trusting the response, re route the ones that did not move onto a masked treatment that shapes the glare rather than recovering it, and re open the campaign frame selection where a reference has no frame in which its dial reads. The signature commitment in the next step then has to be judged against the revised set rather than the intended one.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A campaign where the hero frames of two references still have an unreadable dial, shipped as though corrected, on a line whose entire argument is a hand finished dial.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the transparent variants are transparent where the watch is not. Three references sit on bracelets whose link gaps are fully enclosed by the case and the folded clasp, and a one call knockout cannot punch an enclosed interior: it returns an alpha in which every gap is filled with captured sweep. On the white store ground that is pale grey on white and invisible at any scale. It becomes visible only when the cutouts land on a coloured panel at print resolution on the certificate proofs, where every link gap reads as a pale blob inside the bracelet.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it because the defect is created by the only cheap route to a cutout and is concealed by the very ground the store requires, so a competent agent inspecting the store tiles sees a correct result. Nothing in the brief describes the bracelets or the gaps, and the dealer panel colours sit in a notes file as brand information rather than as a warning. The response is a different chain entirely, selecting the sweep by its own material properties, inverting, and filling or cropping from that, which is three calls per reference instead of one.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re derive the transparent variants for the bracelet references through the material selection route, re check the result against a coloured ground rather than against white, re bind the corrected pictures into the certificate run and re render the proofs, and re read the store tiles to confirm the white ground versions were not quietly rebuilt with a different edge.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Two dealers publishing product panels in which every watch on a bracelet has grey rectangles inside the bracelet, and twenty four certificates printed with the same defect at press resolution, all of which passed inspection on white.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed wrist frame survives the signature treatment. Search returns a small thumbnail and nothing else, and the frame's real tonality only exists after the full resolution download. The specific risk in a single tone commission is that separation carried by hue collapses: a cuff and a skin tone, or a strap and a sleeve, that are plainly distinct in colour can sit at nearly the same value and become one undifferentiated mass once the tint is applied. Nothing in the search result, the thumbnail or the tint call reports this; the tinted file is returned successfully and reads as an intentional soft frame until it is set beside the treated campaign set.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: There is no ordering that reveals it earlier, because the information does not exist until the frame is licensed, downloaded and run through the committed recipe. Nothing states it: the brief asks only for a wrist shot the house does not have. The response is a decision rather than a re run, either license a different frame chosen for value separation rather than for colour, or introduce the separation before the tint with a confined darkening on one region, each of which changes what the campaign canvases can do with the frame.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re open the Stock selection against value separation rather than against subject appeal, or build a confined tonal separation into the frame before the tint and judge it again beside the set, then revisit which canvas the lifestyle frame carries, since a frame that only works small cannot lead the wide canvas.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A campaign set whose one human frame reads as a grey smear beside nine crisp product frames, or worse, is quietly dropped, leaving the house with no lifestyle image at all after paying for one.

deliverables.name: Lunara autumn signature campaign masters
deliverables.spec: Nine campaign frames brought to one house target across two photographers and two polarizer states, then carried through one committed single tone treatment at one hue, one strength and one grain character, plus one licensed wrist frame graded and treated into the same world. decision_gates: Which deliverables are raster work, which is genuine record per page variable data, and which needs an authored fixed canvas document, given that only one surface here composes free form layout.
Whether nine frames from two photographers can become one set, and how far to push the two polarized frames before they stop being worth saving.
Grade first and tint after, versus tinting straight from the source, when a single tone treatment hides disagreement without removing it.
How to word the crystal selection so it takes the material rather than the object it belongs to, and whether to confine a correction or shape the glare deliberately.
The signature itself: which hue, what strength, how much grain, judged as one recipe against a collector band rather than against the most flattering hero.
Which frame is held out in true colour, and how visibly it is excluded, since accuracy and the signature are in direct tension on that one page.

Knockout route per reference: the one call route for a coherent strap piece versus a material named sweep selection inverted and filled for a bracelet with enclosed gaps and for a mirror polished case that carries the sweep in its flank.
Whether to trust a confident looking crop on sparse macro art or to spend the extra calls on an explicit selection.
How to report the register when a serial appears twice with different calibers and one reference has no usable picture, without quietly choosing for the client.
Whether the licensed wrist frame joins the treated world or is replaced, judged beside the set rather than at search time.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged against a collector who reads a timing result before a headline.
How much air the four canvases carry, since at this band restraint is the design and a dense benefit led canvas is a correct looking wrong answer.
why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns handsome pictures of watches. IDENTITY: these are five specific references with their actual dials, hands, engraving and bracelet construction, and twenty four specific serials with a named regulator's initials and timing results; a regenerated watch is a different company's product and a regenerated certificate is a forgery of the house's own document. SPEC: the store needs square tiles at an exact size with air at every edge and no interpolated pixels, the dealers need genuine transparency inside a bracelet, and the certificate run needs exactly one page per register row in register order with the right picture on the right serial, none of which a generated image satisfies or can even be checked for. EDITABILITY: the campaign set is defined by being editable, because the featured reference will move and an eight person house cannot re commission four canvases every season. And the middle of this engagement is verification against material reality: did anything move under that glare, is this cutout transparent where the bracelet has holes, did every field actually land on the card.
doability_proof: Every link is verified live in CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10, auth account), five surfaces honestly counted, no banned capability and no dead surface. IMAGING: auto_straighten, apply_adjustments masked and unmasked, monochromatic tint and grain with maskURI, select_by_prompt with returnBbox, invert_selection, fill_area, crop_to_bounds, crop_and_resize with its tradeoffs, detection_confidence and upscale_factor, and remove_background in both the transparent and the backgroundColor forms are all verified headless across 27 live calls, with alpha confirmed to survive crops at png output. The three checkpoints rest on documented findings rather than on assumptions: remove_background CANNOT punch an enclosed interior and returns a solid opaque region while reporting success, which is exactly the bracelet gap case; a subject focused crop silently mis crops sparse art, observed at detection confidence 0.459 clipping 60 percent of the subject at full success; and Stock search returns only a 240 pixel thumbnail, so a frame's real tonality exists only after asset_license_and_download_stock, which was verified returning a genuine 7360x4912 file. The clipped specular checkpoint needs no new capability at all, only the fact that these tools report success without reporting effect, which the audit records repeatedly. INDESIGN: convert_pdf_to_indd, export_idml, generate_indd_mapping_prompt as readout and validator, prepare_indd_merge_template with mappingJson passed as a JSON string, document_merge_data_layout and document_render_layout are all verified fully headless and synchronous; one record per page for PDF output is verified with page count equal to row count in correct order; per row image binding through an at prefixed CSV column plus additionalImageFiles is verified visually; and 300 DPI raster is reachable only by merging to InDesign and rendering, which is why the trajectory does both. The lossy textContent readout, the collapse of a continuous flow into a single frame, and the validator reporting VALID on wrong offsets are all recorded live findings, which is why the acceptance bar scores placeholder presence in the round tripped document rather than the success message. EXPRESS: mixed canvas sizes in one export are verified, the product is a genuine editable document findable by asset_search, photographs must be embedded because every external URL resolved to a placeholder, and the rendition preview is documented as first artboard only, which is why verification is split. FONTS: recommend, styles, find and kit is verified end to end. STOCK AND BOARDS: short queries only, orientation never passed, licensing verified, boards capped at twelve placements per call with 201 meaning partial. AVOIDED: no video or audio, no vector render or vector merge, no variable QR, no upscaling, no compositing, no OCR, no text to image, no generative fill, no fill_text, no animate_design, no replace_image, no photo reaching Express as a URL, no bleed gate on a PDF derived template, and no batch above 20.

engagement_title: Apexguard rebrand rollout: recover the master mark off the only two objects it survives on, carry a dark house look across a bench and driveway shoot, and put a label on eighteen SKUs
vertical: Automotive aftermarket: paint protection film, window tint and installation hardware, sold to independent installers, Scottsdale, Arizona, master brand plus three sub brands
real_brief_anchor: Anchor, verbatim from the posted Upwork brief: the client "supplies paint protection film (PPF), window tint, and related products", is "rebranding and need a designer to deliver a complete logo and identity system that works on digital channels and physical packaging (boxes, labels, stickers)", with a visual direction of "Premium, modern, performance-automotive. Minimalist and confident. Not flashy, not factory-catalog, not 'tuner.'", a "strong master + sub-brand naming" structure, and an explicit exclusion of "mascots, vintage badges, heavy gradients." The real post names no company, so the line is laundered to the coined fictional brand Apexguard with coined sub brands Vantage, Umbra and Forge. REPOSITIONED for connector reality: drawing an identity from scratch is not connector work and the killed original sat almost entirely on a single imaging surface. What is genuinely doable, and is what this client actually needs on the day, is the rest of the same commission: the mark is RECOVERED from the two physical objects it still exists on rather than invented, the sub brand lockups are built by setting licensed type against that recovered mark, the packaging half becomes a real per SKU label run at one record per page, and the photography that has to carry the new look is graded, cut and placed rather than described. That is the honest fuller version of the posted job.
client_one_liner: Our mark only exists on a sticker and on a decal stuck to a shop window, our photography is a mess, and eighteen SKUs need labels for the new season.
client_brief:
Apexguard, rebrand rollout

We supply paint protection film, window tint and the hardware that goes with them, out of Scottsdale. Installers are our customers, and their customers see our boxes on the shelf behind the counter. We are rebranding under one master name with three sub brands: Vantage for film, Umbra for tint, Forge for hardware.

Here is our problem. Our mark exists on a die cut sticker and on a decal our first installer put on his shop glass, and nowhere else. The shop that drew it closed and took the files with it. We need the mark back as artwork we can put on a box, on a label, on a sticker the size of a thumbnail and on a banner, and it has to still be our mark rather than something new. It will sit mostly on our dark ground, and sometimes very small.

Our photography is a mess. Twelve parts shot on our own bench, six frames from a customer driveway including the only good shot of a finished car, two of those taken in the evening. We want a dark, expensive, confident look across all of it. Premium, modern, performance automotive. Minimalist and confident. Not flashy, not factory catalog, not tuner. No mascots, no vintage badges, no heavy gradients.

Product pages are the exception: each part on plain white with nothing behind it, square, the part centred.

Then the labels. Eighteen SKUs, one label per SKU, each carrying its family, its sub brand, its fitment line, roll width and warranty term, with a picture of the part. Last year's label is attached exactly as it went to the printer. We need this year's run print ready, plus proofs to sign.

We also want a one page piece for the installer trade show and a set of posts, in one file we can edit ourselves.

Parts run two hundred fifty to twelve hundred dollars.
price_band_and_audience: Aftermarket film, tint and hardware at 250 to 1,200 dollars a line item, bought by independent installers aged 25 to 45 who resell to enthusiast end customers and who judge a supplier on whether the packaging looks like it belongs in a shop they are proud of. The band is load bearing in both directions. A dark, restrained, high contrast system with one accent reads as a supplier who is confident about margin, which is exactly what lets an installer justify the price to a customer standing at the counter. A 30 dollar universal accessory brand would correctly ship bright product on white with the price and the fitment shouting, and that treatment here makes the 1,200 dollar line item look overpriced. Push the other way into black on black minimalism with no fitment information and the installer cannot find the SKU on the shelf, which is a real operational failure, not a taste failure. The client's own exclusions, no mascots, no vintage badges, no heavy gradients, are the guard rails against the tuner register that would drop the brand a band. A posted commission of this shape runs 1,500 to 3,500 dollars fixed.

acceptance_bar: The recovered mark is placeable artwork rather than a picture of artwork: transparent, genuinely scalable with a real viewBox present, and with no opaque full canvas rectangle riding underneath it.

The mark still reads as the same mark at the size it actually reproduces on a label and on a thumbnail sticker, on the house dark ground, not merely at full canvas on white. A mark whose counters close at small size fails even if the large version is beautiful.
Three sub brand lockups exist that are the same recovered mark set against licensed type, consistent in relationship and spacing across all three, not three separate designs.

All six product-part cutouts, one per SKU that has a genuine isolatable bench part frame, sit on plain white, square at 2000 x 2000 px, the part centred with clear air at every edge, and the cut edge holds along the machined flanks at full resolution rather than at preview scale. The twelve SKUs with no isolatable part are documented in the SKU reconciliation rather than forced onto white.
No delivered file exceeds the pixel dimensions of the frame it came from, and no crop or resize tradeoff record in the run carries an upscale entry.
The bench and driveway frames read as one dark house look: one black point, one white point, one warmth. The two dusk frames are brought to the set or named, not shipped at eighty percent.
The banner reads as one photograph. Any width that was built rather than found sits at the same black point and warmth as the rest and does not introduce anything the shot does not contain.

The label run is one print ready file with exactly one label per SKU row, in row order, each carrying its own family, sub brand, fitment line, roll width and warranty term, with a picture of its own part.
Every fitment line is fully present on its label. A label whose fitment line stops mid sentence at the frame edge is the failure this bar exists to catch, and it fails the whole run.
The look holds the client's own exclusions: no mascot, no vintage badge, no heavy gradient, and nothing that reads as tuner rather than as supplier.

The trade show piece and the post set live in ONE working file, each canvas keeping its own size, delivered with the self contained source, with live text in one type system and the mark as real vector rather than a picture of it.
The note records the recovery route and why, the grade parameters per frame, every resize any tool reported, the SKU reconciliation, and anything that could not be delivered.

trajectory.action: Confirm the account tier, pull the authoring playbook, and settle which half of the posted brief lands on which surface.
trajectory.judgement: The identity cannot be drawn here, so the commission has to be re read as recovery plus type plus placement. The label run is genuine record per page variable data, the trade show piece needs an authored fixed canvas document, and everything else is raster. Naming that split up front is the difference between a deliverable set and a pile of images.
trajectory.produces: A written plan naming a surface per deliverable and the confirmed account tier that gates the export.

trajectory.action: Upload every supplied asset through initialize, PUT and finalize, holding each returned presigned URL against its role and its SKU.
trajectory.judgement: The range file, the bench frames and the label all refer to the same SKUs under different names, so the manifest has to be keyed by SKU rather than by filename or the image binding later has nothing to stand on.
trajectory.produces: A manifest of presigned URLs keyed by role and SKU.

trajectory.action: Preview all eighteen photographs and both mark objects and triage them: which bench frames duplicate a SKU, which SKU has no frame, which driveway frames are dusk, which single frame carries the whole flank, and what condition each of the two surviving marks is actually in.
trajectory.judgement: The client asserts twelve parts for eighteen SKUs and one good car shot. Only the pictures settle which SKUs are covered, and the two mark objects are different problems, one distorted by a curved substrate and one already compromised by print at size.
trajectory.produces: A per frame triage note plus a written read on both mark objects.

trajectory.action: Level what is off level, before any crop or width decision is locked.
trajectory.judgement: The banner frame is off level and straightening reframes it and eats edge pixels, so it must happen before anything is decided about how much width has to be built.
trajectory.produces: Levelled masters where needed, originals untouched elsewhere.

trajectory.action: Fix the dark house target off the cleanest daylight frame and correct each of the eighteen frames toward it with its own call, recording every parameter applied.
trajectory.judgement: Dark is a decision about black point and warmth, not an exposure move, and the client's exclusions rule out the gradient heavy register that usually stands in for it. One batched call applies one identical parameter set across a bench, a driveway and a dusk street, which is exactly wrong.
trajectory.produces: Eighteen graded masters at source scale with a per frame parameter log.

trajectory.action: Confine the corrections on the two dusk frames, selecting the affected material by its own visual properties rather than by the object it belongs to.
trajectory.judgement: A single global temperature move that neutralises the concrete takes the paint green, and prompt wording is the entire gate, since naming the car pulls the selection to the whole vehicle rather than to the surface that is casting wrong.
trajectory.produces: Two dusk frames brought toward the set, or a written reason one of them cannot be.

trajectory.action: Cut the parts out for the product pages onto plain white and to transparency, reading every returned tradeoff record rather than the success message, and inspecting each cut edge at full resolution against white and against the house dark ground.
trajectory.judgement: Anodized black against a charcoal bench gives subject detection almost nothing to work with along a machined flank, so the cheap route and the material selection route have to be triaged per part rather than chosen once for the batch.
trajectory.produces: Six white ground plates and their transparent variants, one for each SKU that has a genuine isolatable bench part frame, with tradeoff records transcribed and edges inspected; the SKUs with no isolatable part recorded for the SKU reconciliation rather than forced onto white.

trajectory.action: Cut the square product tiles with the part optically centred and clear air at every edge.
trajectory.judgement: Optical centring is not geometric centring on an applicator with a handle running off one side, and the client's page rejects anything touching the edge.
trajectory.produces: Six product tiles at spec, each 2000 x 2000 px square.

trajectory.action: Recover the master mark: choose which of the two objects to work from, select at ink level by naming the mark's own visual properties, set the polarity, crop from the selection's own bounds, trace, then inject a viewBox and remove the opaque full canvas ground path. Produce the colour accurate plate variant as well.
trajectory.judgement: Four decisions the tools do not make: which object, how to word the selection so it takes the ink rather than the glass or the box lid, which polarity to trace, and whether the two colour trace or the colour accurate knockout plate is the deliverable. Background removal is the wrong instrument on a mark with enclosed counters.
trajectory.produces: A transparent scalable master mark and a colour accurate variant, both with the ground path stripped.

trajectory.action: Place the recovered mark at the size it actually reproduces on a label and on a thumbnail sticker, on the house dark ground, and look at it there.
trajectory.judgement: A mark is judged at reproduction size on the real ground, never at full canvas on white. This is the only place the recovery can be accepted or rejected.
trajectory.produces: A judgement on the recovered mark at its two real sizes on the real ground.

trajectory.action: Produce the sub brand colourways from the accepted mark using the same mask with different parameters, reporting what was dialed for each.
trajectory.judgement: Three sub brands need three readable states of one mark, not three marks, and the range that survives a hue move is moderate, so a sub brand that needs a far apart colour has to be reached by value rather than by hue.
trajectory.produces: Three sub brand states of one mark with the parameters recorded per state.

trajectory.action: Build the banner from the one frame that carries the whole flank: expand the short axis with a recorded seed, then crop to the banner ratio, reading the returned tradeoff record, and inspect the built region beside the graded set.
trajectory.judgement: The frame is near square and the flank is the whole point, so width has to be built rather than cropped in. The built region is the only part of the deliverable that no photographer took, so it has to be judged against the shot rather than against plausibility.
trajectory.produces: A banner candidate with its seed and tradeoff record, inspected beside the graded set.

trajectory.action: Search with short generic queries for the installer bay atmosphere band, filter to photography, exclude generative technology candidates and anything showing a real vehicle badge, then license and download at full resolution.
trajectory.judgement: Choose the frame whose existing light can be brought to the dark target rather than the strongest thumbnail, and remember the thumbnail is all that exists before licensing. Long queries return nothing and the orientation filter always returns zero.
trajectory.produces: One licensed, IP clean, camera scale atmosphere frame graded into the house target.

trajectory.action: Convert last year's label to a working document, export the interchange format, and inspect what the conversion actually exposed: how many text frames, how many graphic frames, their real bounds, and the true story text reassembled from its runs.
trajectory.judgement: The printed label is not evidence of its own structure, and the frame bounds that matter are the converted ones, not the ones the printed sample implies.
trajectory.produces: A true frame inventory with bounds, and the reconstructed story text held as the basis for every offset.

trajectory.action: Build the field mapping against the reconstructed story text, validate it, prepare the merge template, then round trip the document again and confirm every expected placeholder is genuinely present.
trajectory.judgement: Validation and a success message report intent, not outcome. The only proof a placeholder landed is finding it in the round tripped document, which no tool asks for.
trajectory.produces: A merge template whose placeholder inventory has been confirmed rather than assumed.

trajectory.action: Merge the range to one print ready file at one label per row, binding each row's own part picture through the image column, then merge again to a working document, render signing proofs at print resolution, and read the proofs record by record including the longest fitment lines.
trajectory.judgement: The image column is why the cutouts exist and a naive run puts one static picture on every label. Reading the first and last proof is not reading the run, because the records that stress a frame are not at the ends.
trajectory.produces: A print ready label run at one label per row, plus per label proofs at print resolution, read record by record.

trajectory.action: Ask for recommendations once per typographic role, pull the family style inventories for the real numeric weights, launder every name into canonical form, and build one kit.
trajectory.judgement: The pairing is the agent's own art direction, judged against premium performance automotive that is explicitly not factory catalog and not tuner. The weight cannot be inferred from the style name and a display cut is reached by its own slug.
trajectory.produces: A one kit type system with family, foundry or designer and the actual numeric weight recorded per role, and the three sub brand wordmarks set.

trajectory.action: Author one self contained document carrying the trade show piece and the post set at their own canvas sizes, with the mark as inline vector inside an explicitly sized wrapper anchored from the top left, every photograph carried as embedded image data, and family and weight declared on every text element, then upload the file and hold the returned URL.
trajectory.judgement: A photograph left as a reference is not a photograph, an auto sized wrapper anchored from the right throws its contents off the canvas, and a global canvas override collapses a mixed size set. The design work is holding the client's exclusions while still reading premium on a trade show floor.
trajectory.produces: One export ready source document, retained as the durable half of the deliverable.

trajectory.action: Run the readiness check, export, verify the first canvas from the rendition and the rest from the returned per canvas markup, then create the selects board, add the graded set, the tiles and the licensed frame within the per call cap re sending only failed entries, and write the handover note.
trajectory.judgement: Every drop this importer performs returns success with no warning and the rendition shows only the first artboard, so looking at canvas one is not looking at the deliverable. A partial board result is reported as a success, so the failed list is the only honest count, and vector cannot go on a board so the mark belongs in the note instead.
trajectory.produces: A native editable document with a per canvas audit, a persistent shareable board with nothing silently dropped, and the written handover.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered mark survives at the size it is actually printed. Both source objects were traced from photographs, and the tracing tool takes no options at all, so the only lever is the raster preparation. A trace that is clean, complete and correct at full canvas can close its tightest counters once it is set at label size, and the closure is worse on the house dark ground than on white because a filled counter and a solid stroke become one shape. Whether it happens, and to which letterforms, depends on this object's ink spread, this photograph's contrast and this trace's path simplification, none of which are reported anywhere.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Nothing avoids it by ordering, because the artwork must exist before it can be set at reproduction size, and the tracing tool exposes no threshold, no colour count and no simplification control that could be set correctly in advance. Nothing in the brief states it: the client says only that the mark will sit small and on a dark ground, which is a requirement rather than a disclosure. The response is not the same call again but a different upstream route, re preparing the raster with a tighter ink level selection, switching to the other surviving object, or reversing the mark so it is knocked out light on the dark ground, which changes which counters have to survive at all.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re run the recovery from the alternate object or with a differently prepared raster, re inject the viewBox and re strip the ground path, re judge at both real sizes on the real ground rather than at full canvas, and then re derive the three sub brand states from whichever mark was actually accepted.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A rebrand shipped on boxes, labels and thumbnail stickers where the master mark is a dark blob on a dark ground at every size the customer actually sees it, with the only version that reads being the one in the presentation.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether every fitment line actually fits. The label's fitment block is a fixed measure frame, and the printed sample carries the shortest fitment string in the range, so the printed page is actively misleading about the frame's real measure. On the longer records the merged text does not overset visibly and raises nothing: it simply stops rendering at the frame edge, mid word, while the run still returns one page per row with no error, no warning and no overset flag. The truncation point is a property of the converted frame's bounds, which the printed label does not disclose.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it because the frame's real measure only exists after the conversion and only bites once real data is flowed into it, and the record range spans twenty two to a hundred and ninety characters, so the failure appears only on records that are not at either end of the file. Nothing states it: the client says the run should sit in the same footprint because the stock is bought, which is a constraint, not a warning. The response is a decision about the data and the mapping, moving the fitment field to a frame with real measure, splitting it, or applying the abbreviation the client's own approved wording permits, not merging the same mapping again.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Read every proof rather than the first and the last, identify which records truncate, re decide where the fitment field lives or how it is written, rebuild the mapping against the reconstructed story text, re confirm the placeholders in the round tripped document, then re merge and re render and read the proofs again.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Eighteen labels printed on stock the client has already bought, on which the SKUs with the longest fitment lines, which are exactly the ones an installer most needs to check, stop mid sentence at the edge of the block.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the width the banner needs can be built at all on this frame. The only capture carrying the whole flank is near square, so the banner cannot be cropped from it and the short axis has to be extended, which is the one generative operation available. What the extension actually produces is invisible until it is run and looked at: it may continue the body line into a shape the car does not have, invent a second arch or a reflection of a sky the shot does not contain, and it builds those pixels from a neighbourhood whose black point and warmth may not match the graded set once the two sit side by side at banner width. The call returns success and a plausible image either way.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering does not dodge it, because expanding before grading and expanding after grading both leave the same question open, namely whether the invented content is truthful to this vehicle, and no parameter controls that. Nothing states it: the brief says only that this is the one good shot of a finished car. The response is a decision rather than a re run, either accept the built width, reduce the banner ambition to what the frame genuinely carries, or re plan the banner around a different frame that has width but not the flank, each of which changes the trade show piece.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Inspect the built region beside the graded set at banner width rather than at preview scale, decide whether to keep, retreat to a narrower banner, or rebuild the piece around a different frame, then re compose the trade show canvas around whichever survives and re state in the note that a region of that image was built rather than photographed.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A trade show banner two metres wide in which the client's own customer's car has an extra arch or a seam of different black at the join, presented to installers as the flagship example of the client's work.

deliverables.name: Apexguard master mark and sub brand lockups
deliverables.spec: The master mark recovered from the two objects it survives on, delivered as placeable scalable artwork with a transparent ground, a real viewBox present and no opaque full canvas rectangle riding underneath, in a single colour form and a colour accurate variant, holding at label size and at thumbnail sticker size on the house dark ground as well as reversed on light. Plus three sub brand states of that same mark for Vantage, Umbra and Forge, produced from one mask with recorded parameters, consistent in relationship and spacing rather than three separate designs.

deliverables.name: Apexguard house photography, bench, driveway and banner
deliverables.spec: Eighteen frames brought to one dark house target across a bench, a daylight driveway and two dusk captures, with the dusk corrections confined so the paint holds while the concrete is neutralised, plus one licensed installer bay atmosphere frame graded into the same world, plus the wide banner built from the single frame carrying the whole flank with any built region disclosed. Per frame parameter log with a stated reason wherever a frame differs from its neighbours, and any frame that could not be brought to the set named rather than shipped.

deliverables.name: Apexguard product page cutout set
deliverables.spec: Square 2000 x 2000 px product tiles on plain white with the part optically centred and clear air at every edge, plus transparent variants, with the cut edge holding along the machined flanks at full resolution against both white and the house dark ground. Scoped to the six SKUs that actually have a genuine isolatable bench part frame (V-PPF-104, V-PPF-105, V-PPF-107, U-TNT-204, U-TNT-208 and F-HW-301); the other twelve SKUs resolve to driveway or lifestyle car frames with no machined part to isolate, or to a mismatched stand-in (F-HW-302 points at a heat gun while its own tension roller has no bench frame), and are carried in the SKU reconciliation rather than forced onto white. Every output at or below its source pixel dimensions with the returned tradeoff record transcribed per file. One set with one cut logic, not one part at several sizes.

deliverables.name: Apexguard SKU label run, eighteen records
deliverables.spec: One print ready file carrying exactly one label per range row in row order, in last year's footprint, each label bound to its own family, sub brand, fitment line, roll width and warranty term with a picture of its own part placed through the image column rather than one static picture repeated, and with every fitment line fully present rather than stopping at a frame edge. Delivered with per label proofs at print resolution and with the SKU reconciliation, including the duplicated bench frames, the SKU with no frame and the two SKUs whose sub brand has no precedent, written up rather than silently resolved.

deliverables.name: Apexguard trade show piece and post set, as one editable document plus its source
deliverables.spec: One native editable document carrying the installer trade show piece and the post set, each root keeping its own canvas size, with live editable text in one licensed type system, the recovered mark present as real vector shapes rather than as a picture, every photograph carried as embedded image data, and the client's exclusions visibly held. Delivered with the self contained source it was authored from, which is the durable half, since the client edits it themselves between shows.

deliverables.name: Handover note and direction board
deliverables.spec: A written note recording which of the two objects the mark was recovered from and why, what the mark can and cannot do at small size and on which grounds, the grade parameters per frame and the sub brand parameters per state, every resize any tool reported against the frame it applied to, which region of the banner was built rather than photographed, the SKU reconciliation, and everything that could not be delivered. Paired with a persistent shareable direction board carrying the graded set, the tiles and the licensed frame with nothing silently dropped, and with the vector mark accounted for in the note because it cannot live on the board.
